response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 13+ years across web, backend, mobile and some embedded work, and demonstrable strength in low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems (Sociomantic/dunnhumby) and event-driven architecture (GISCollective). However, the role is fundamentally a hands-on C++ platform/architecture position in industrial automation, and his C++ exposure is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus an academic project; the last decade has been TypeScript/Node.js, D and cloud web products. There is no evidence of STL-heavy modern C++, IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, MQTT or industrial protocols, or industrial automation domain experience. The transferable systems and craftsmanship skills are real, but the gap against the core technical and security requirements is too large for a mid-senior hire expected to mentor others on C++ and secure coding standards.
strengths: Deep experience with high-performance, low-latency, concurrent distributed systems
Broad full-stack range plus Node.js, React, cloud and Kubernetes/DevOps exposure
Strong engineering-practice culture: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, public talks and workshops
concerns: C++/STL experience is minimal and over a decade out of date
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL or secure-coding standards background
No demonstrated MQTT, message brokers or industrial protocol (OPC UA, Modbus) work

key_factors.factor: High-performance concurrent distributed systems track record
